title: Comment box
description: A comment field with an Attach a file link button underneath. One file per comment: images, PDF, Word, Excel or CSV, up to 3 MB. The chosen file shows as a chip with its size and a remove button. A file of the wrong type or size shows a red message and is not added. The parent keeps the text and the file; this component checks the file.

props.x: The attached file, kept by the parent.
Called with a file that passed the checks.

props.d: "Up to 3 MB. Images, PDF, Word, Excel or CSV."

values.v: Link button, paperclip icon, shifted 14px left so its text lines up with the field
one file, 3 MB, images, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV

usedIn: School Requests - Self Service and Ticket Inbox (Add a comment and Message to the school).
